Caring for Shared Spaces

For anyone who wants the places we all use to feel a little better. Each day is one small way to look after parks, sidewalks, buses, libraries and other shared spaces, and to make them kinder for the next person.

Values · Values · Habits · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Stop by a park near you and notice one small thing someone has done to keep it pleasant for everyone.
  • Day 2Look at the sidewalk outside your door this morning and nudge one stray wrapper or bottle cap into your bin, using a tissue or glove.
  • Day 3Smile and say a warm thank you to one person working at a library, cafe or front desk today.
  • Day 4Hold the elevator door for a neighbor in your building and offer a friendly hello.
  • Day 5Picture a shared place you love, like a park or a library, and name one thing that makes it feel good to be there.
  • Day 6Tuck a pair of garden gloves and a small bag into your coat pocket, so you are ready to pick up a little litter on your next walk.
  • Day 7Sweep the leaves off the sidewalk in front of your home this fall, so neighbors have a clear, dry path.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Find out when your local community garden holds its next open volunteer hour.
  • Day 60Borrow a seed packet from your library's seed library, if it has one, and plant it this spring.
  • Day 120Tell someone about a shared place that helped you through a hard season.
  • Day 240Walk a different route home and look for a shared space you never noticed before.
  • Day 365End the day by writing one sentence about a shared place you helped or noticed, and how it felt.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
